entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.28.4
entries.body: - **Sync now on your phone:** if you use Bridge Bank, the Accounts tab now starts with a Bank sync card that shows when your banks last synced and fetches new transactions straight away, the same as the card in the sidebar on a computer. It is ready again an hour after the last sync.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.28.2
entries.body: - **Sync now:** if you use Bridge Bank, a Bank sync card at the bottom of the sidebar shows when your banks last synced and fetches new transactions straight away. Banks only allow a few syncs a day, so it is ready again an hour after the last sync.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.28
entries.body:
- **Dates day first again:** targets, schedules, reports and Recently deleted show dates like 5 Oct and 5 October 2026.
- **Overspent in the budget's last month:** the Overspent amount beside Ready to Assign now shows in the last month too, where it used to read 0.
- **No late one-off payments from the assistant:** a one-off payment can no longer be dated in the past from the Claude connector, the same as on the budget screen.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.26
entries.body:
- **US English throughout:** license, organize and categorize, and Settings says Check this instead of Tick.
- **Dates in US order:** targets, schedules, reports and Recently deleted show dates like Oct 5 and October 5, 2026.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.25
entries.body:
- **Ready to Assign goes down when you assign:** moving money from Ready to Assign into a category now always lowers it by that amount. Before, if the category was overspent, or a later month had moved money out of it, the money quietly filled that gap and Ready to Assign stayed the same.
- **Overspending shows on its own:** overspent money now shows in the red Overspent amount instead of being taken off Ready to Assign, like YNAB, and the Overspent button can use all of Ready to Assign to cover it.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.22
entries.body:
- **Assigned on your phone:** the phone budget now has an Assigned column next to Available, so when you look ahead to a later month you can see what you've already put in each category.
- **Where later money went:** in the month summary, Assigned in later months now lists each category and month it's in (money taken back shows as a minus). Tap or click one to jump to that month.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.19
entries.body:
- **Moving between months, no flicker:** a month now appears all at once with its own numbers (Ready to Assign, Underfunded, Overspent, the categories and the side panel), instead of briefly showing the previous month's amounts. The months either side load in the background, so the arrows switch right away, even the first time after opening the app.
- **30-day free trial:** the trial buttons and notes now say 30 days.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.18.9
entries.body:
- **Ready to Assign tells the truth:** it now holds back everything later months need: money already assigned in later months, and this month's overspending, which comes out of next month. If you've assigned more than you have, it shows a negative number. The month summary lists both parts.
- **Adding a target:** done from the category's side panel only; rows no longer show an Add target button on hover.
- **Clearer target errors:** if a target can't be saved you see why, the date stays in its box when you click away, and a one-off payment can't be dated in the past.
- **No more flicker:** Ready to Assign appears together with the rest of the budget, with the right number, when the page loads and when you move between months.
- **Sharp header on iPhone:** the top of the screen is no longer dimmed and blurred under the clock, in Safari and in the Home Screen app, light and dark.
- **Clear filter:** account pages have a Clear filter button next to the filters, handy after opening a category's activity from the budget.
- **Clicking a category just selects it:** the side panel opens without jumping into the target editor. Use Edit in the panel to change a target.
- **Assistant box clears itself:** after Open in Claude or ChatGPT, the box is empty and ready for the next question.
- **Outflow and Inflow:** the Payment and Deposit columns now use YNAB's names, and money coming in is green, on the computer and the phone.
- **Filters in plain words:** yes/no filters read as one phrase (Cleared, Not cleared, Only transfers, No transfers) instead of "is true" or "is false", and the rest read naturally: "is any of", "is at least", "is on or after", "Category is any of Groceries, Gadgets or Family".

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.18.3
entries.body:
- **Every payment is in Schedules:** a target with a date is a payment, so it goes to Schedules by itself, gets matched when it's paid, and changing it in the budget or in Schedules changes both. Editing a bill's target edits its amount, date and how often right there. Weekly targets can be payments too.
- **All targets in one place:** Schedules now lists the targets that aren't payments (spending money like groceries, savings to keep) under Budget targets. Tap one to edit it.
- **Recently deleted:** under More (Deleted on the phone). Everything deleted in the last 30 days, on any device: transactions, categories, groups, schedules, payees, accounts and targets, each with Restore. Deleting a payment's target deletes its schedule too, and Restore brings both back.
- **Dates on a calendar:** pick when the money is needed by, or the next payment, from a calendar.
- **Start later:** a target can start asking in a later month and asks for nothing before it. New targets start in the month on screen.
- **Clearer choices:** Put in an amount each time, Top up to an amount, Pay an amount on a date, or Keep an amount in the category, each with a line saying what it does.
- **Edit from the budget:** click a category's target bar to open its target, or Add target on a category without one.
- **Notes on targets:** add a note when you create or edit a target. A payment's note is the same one Schedules shows.
- **Ready to Assign counts later months:** money already assigned in a later month is left out of this month's Ready to Assign, like YNAB. The month summary shows how much, and Auto-Assign won't hand it out twice.
- **Overspent says where:** the overspent button names the category, or lists them when there are several.
- **Phone:** link transactions to a schedule, assign Ready to Assign or take it back from the month sheet, tap the month to jump to any month (Today brings you back), and custom reports have a way back.
- **Cleaner pickers:** the payee, category and account dropdowns now look like the rest of the budget.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.13.7
entries.body:
- **Bill reminders:** turn them on in Settings, Bill reminders, and you get a notification at 9:00 the day before a bill in Schedules is due, with what it comes to. Works where Bridge Budget is on your Home Screen (iPhone and iPad) or in the Dock (Mac), and in browsers that show notifications. Each device is turned on separately.
- **Reports for one account:** pick an account next to the date range, or keep All accounts.
- **Where your money moved:** every move between categories is now kept, like YNAB's move history. The category sheet lists the month's moves under Assigned (to or from which category, and when), the month view has a Recent moves list, and moves from before this update are read back from the month notes where possible. The category sheet also shows what was left over from last month.
- **Late bills on the app icon:** where Bridge Budget is in the Dock or on the Home Screen, its icon shows how many bills are late (on iPhone, once notifications are allowed).
- **Activity instead of Spent:** the column holds refunds and sales too, so it has YNAB's name again. Reports no longer let a payback in one category cancel out the month's spending.
- **Assistant setup:** Settings now says to switch Bridge Budget on and allow it in each assistant app, the phone apps included.
- **Bill targets show the amount:** a category that saves for a bill now shows what the bill comes to and when it is due, and the total when it saves for several.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.13.2
entries.body:
- **Bill reminders:** turn them on in Settings, Bill reminders, and you get a notification at 9:00 the day before a bill in Schedules is due, with what it comes to. Works where Bridge Budget is on your Home Screen (iPhone and iPad) or in the Dock (Mac), and in browsers that show notifications. Each device is turned on separately.
- **Bill targets show the amount:** a category that saves for a bill now shows what the bill comes to and when it is due, and the total when it saves for several.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.11.11
entries.body:
- **Loans stay one schedule:** Until paid off no longer adds a separate last-payment schedule. When the last payment is next, the amount drops to the smaller remainder by itself, so it is expected and budgeted at exactly that. Loans made with the previous version are turned into one schedule automatically.
- **First payment starts today** when you choose Until paid off.
- **Connect your assistant** now sits under Ask your assistant on the budget.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.11.9
entries.body:
- **Loans and installments:** a schedule can be paid Once, Repeat, or run Until paid off. Enter the total and what you pay per month, and Bridge Budget works out the payments. A smaller last payment gets its own schedule, so it is expected and budgeted at exactly that amount.
- **Connect your assistant from the budget:** until Claude or ChatGPT is connected, a button at the top of the budget takes you straight to the steps.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.11.4
entries.body:
- **Choose how long a bill runs:** a repeating schedule now has a How long field: until you stop it, for a number of months, for a number of payments or until a date. It shows how many payments that comes to and the date of the last one.
- **Picking a payee fills in the rest:** a new schedule takes the account, amount and budget category from that payee's last payment.
- **New schedules start as one-off payments:** check Repeats, right next to the date, for a recurring bill. The date you picked stays.
- **Colors in every category list:** moving money, covering overspending and picking a category show balances green when funded, amber when short of the target and red when overspent. Money coming in goes to Ready to Assign, and Starting Balances is gone from the list.
- **Works offline, syncs by itself:** changes made without a connection are kept, and Bridge Budget now reconnects and syncs them as soon as your server is reachable again, without a reload.
- **Tidier schedule editor:** notes grow as you type, Add and Cancel are always in view, and notes show an icon on the phone.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.11
entries.body:
- **Money that comes in counts toward targets:** a refund, a repayment or money from someone else now funds a category's bill or save-by-date target, like in YNAB. A bill that is already covered shows as funded instead of asking for more.
- **Renaming a schedule no longer breaks its target:** the target follows the schedule when you rename it, and a deleted schedule's bill comes off its category's target instead of showing an error.
- **Schedule names with a colon** now work everywhere.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.07.4
entries.body:
The first public release of Bridge Budget.

- **Switch from YNAB in a minute:** paste a YNAB personal access token and your accounts, transactions, schedules, monthly budgets and targets come across.
- **Bills can share a category:** put water, power and gas in Utilities and their amounts add up, each by its own due date.
- **Fund everything in one click:** Ready to Assign can fill every underfunded target at once, or cover everything you overspent.
- **Late payments:** a scheduled payment that has not arrived shows as *Expected, not arrived*. If it turns up within 30 days, it still links to its schedule and lands in its category.
- **Notes on schedules:** jot down why a bill exists or who shares it. The note shows in the schedules list.
- **On your phone:** the budget, targets, reports and schedules all work in your phone's browser.
- **Undo and Redo:** buttons on the budget, or Cmd+Z and Shift+Cmd+Z.
- **Privacy mode:** hide every amount with one click.
- **Download logs:** one file to email if something goes wrong, with account numbers and passwords masked.
- **Updates:** Bridge Budget tells you when a new version is out, with the one command to install it, and saves a copy of your budgets first.
